correctness.rationale: Explicit gradient contradicts at every possible geometric singular point; 12 distinct rational tangent lines cover all 57 rational projective points by square-coset proof. Hasse plus the Picard degree-three line-bundle classification reduces every smooth cubic over F7 to 336 finite normal forms. An exact stdlib exhaustive verifier loops over all, isolating eight models; translation and inversion in E(F7) identifies them as one rational PGL3 class. Lines and conics cannot tangent-fill, so the minimum irreducible degree is three. Limits and exact scripts are in RESULT.md.
